Use Image 1 as the starting frame.
Shot 1: Smooth handheld push-in over Image 2’s shoulder as she continues tearing open the coral lipstick carton with precise one-handed movements. She keeps her attention on the packaging while the phone beside the faucet vibrates, untouched.

Shot 2: Gradual macro push-in as Image 2 steadies the tube, twists the lipstick bullet upward, and turns it between her fingers so the sunlight briefly catches its surface. Keep the hand motion controlled and tactile.

Shot 3: Static lock-off as Image 2 applies the lipstick in the mirror, pauses mid-smile at a distant subway rumble, then checks her phone and takes the black sunglasses. She speaks softly to her reflection before sweeping out of frame, ending with the coral lipstick as the visual focus. Preserve subtle sunlight reflections and natural hand movement throughout.

Image 2 says in a softly assured, lightly amused tone: <d>[English] Okay. City’s waiting.</d>

overall_soundscape: quiet bathroom ambience with faint city noise and a distant subway rumble. phone vibrating beside the faucet, paper carton tearing, lipstick tube twisting and clicking, soft footsteps moving away. No BGM, no music. Generate only dialogue, environmental sounds, and action sounds.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the blonde woman seen from multiple angles and distances in <Picture 2>, characterized by long wavy hair, a black turtleneck top, high-waist black trousers, and black flat leather shoes. She is also the source of the voice in this scene.
<Subject 2> is the woman's position relative to the bathroom sink and mirror shown in <Picture 1>. She wears long, wavy blonde hair, a fitted black long-sleeved turtleneck, and is positioned in front of a black marble sink with a polished chrome faucet against a white subway-tiled wall.

summary:
[video editing + keyframe completion] The target video is a 6-second continuous sequence that begins with the opening frame of <Picture 1> and progresses to the woman completing a lipstick application. The scene follows <Subject 2> in a pristine white-tiled bathroom as she opens a coral lipstick carton, twists the bullet, takes a few seconds to apply it using the mirror, picks up a pair of black sunglasses <Subject 1>, and exits the frame, creating a natural transition for a following clip.

<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - Retains the exact visual layout of the bathroom, marble sink, and mirror from <Picture 1>.

detailed_description:
This commercial-style video is shot on a 16:9 aspect ratio at a 6-second duration with a realistic, high-fidelity lifestyle aesthetic. Warm, natural morning sunlight streams in from the side, creating soft contrast on the white subway tile and polished black marble sink. 

[Shot 1] The camera starts with a smooth handheld push-in at a slow speed. The framing captures <Subject 2> from behind and over her shoulder. <Subject 2> is in profile, gazing intently at the black marble sink. A smartphone is resting at the base of the chrome faucet. <Subject 2> uses one hand to hold a coral-red lipstick carton steady while her other hand precisely tears open the paper seal with a sharp, continuous "tsssh" sound.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a tight macro push-in. The framing focuses on <Subject 2>'s hands resting on the sink edge. She withdraws the lipstick bullet from its base, twisting the circular mechanism upward. The metallic casing makes a faint, crisp "click" as the coral bullet becomes fully visible. Sunlight catches the smooth, matte surface of the makeup as she rotates the tube, holding it poised and steady.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a static lock-off shot of the mirror wall. <Subject 1> is now seen clearly in the mirror after completing the makeup application. <Subject 1> (S1) looks into her own eyes, then lifts a pair of black rectangular sunglasses from the counter and places them on her face. Just as she puts on the sunglasses, a faint, distant subway rumble vibrates through the floor, and she pauses—her expression softening into a slight, poised smile. She then retrieves a cream-colored canvas tote bag from an unseen location off-screen to the right and gives the mirror one last, quick glance.

<d>[English] Okay. City's waiting.</d>

She turns around and smoothly exits the frame to the right, leaving the lit mirror, the marble sink, and the coral lipstick bullet as the final visual focal point.

overall_soundscape:
The environment is characterized by a clean, quiet bathroom ambience with a faint, low-humming distant city noise. The audio track is rich in micro-details, specifically sharp paper tearing, a crisp, metallic clicking sound for the lipstick twisting, a deep, muffled subway rumble, and the soft, rhythmic sound of flat leather shoes fading away on the tiled floor.
